title: Optimal growth under irreversible pollution: The Forster-Ramsey model
abstract: arXiv:2609.12693v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study optimal growth in a Ramsey economy with irreversible pollution, where the natural absorption capacity is non-monotonic and non-concave a la Forster. In the absence of pollution control, the capital dynamics decouple from pollution, and we characterize a simple threshold on the maximal absorption capacity above which the optimal path is sustainable and below which an optimal regime of irreversible pollution sets in. We then introduce an optimal abatement pollution control to assess whether irreversible pollution ceases to be optimal. We derive a four-dimensional dynamical system for capital, consumption, pollution and the (shadow) cost of pollution, coupled with an algebraic rule for optimal abatement, which is eventually reduced to dimension three, with abatement linearly entering the pollution dynamics. translated_title: 不可逆污染下的最优增长：Forster-Ramsey模型
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有不可逆污染的Ramsey经济中的最优增长问题，其中自然吸收能力按照Forster的方式呈非单调且非凹的特征。在没有污染控制的情况下，资本动态与污染相互解耦，我们对最大吸收能力刻画了一个简单的阈值：当其高于该阈值时，最优路径是可持续的；低于该阈值时，则进入不可逆污染的最优状态。随后，我们引入最优污染减排控制，以评估不可逆污染是否不再是最优选择。我们推导了一个关于资本、消费、污染以及污染（影子）成本的四维动力系统，并结合最优减排的代数规则，最终将其降维至三维，其中减排以线性形式进入污染动态。我们的主要结果是：最优减排会移动这一不可逆性阈值，但并不能将其消除。更重要的是，我们……
tldr: 该研究在Forster-Ramsey模型中刻画了决定经济可持续性的最大吸收能力阈值，并证明最优减排政策只能移动而无法消除不可逆污染的阈值。
en_tdlr: This study characterizes a threshold on maximal absorption capacity determining sustainability in the Forster-Ramsey model with irreversible pollution, and shows that optimal abatement shifts but does not eliminate the irreversibility threshold.
